</script>
</head><body id="game_frame" style="margin:0;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;"><script>
(async () => {
    const b64 = document.getElementById("payload").textContent.trim();
    const binary = atob(b64);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);

    const decompressedStream =
        new Response(
            new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"))
        );

    const decompressed = await decompressedStream.arrayBuffer();
    const blob = new Blob([decompressed], { type: "text/javascript" });
    const dataURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

    {let t;Object.defineProperty(window,"main",{configurable:!0,enumerable:!0,get(){return this._main},set(v){this._main=()=>{clearTimeout(t);v()};t=setTimeout(this._main,200)}})}

    // WASM-GC Singleplayer fix by colbster937
    Worker.prototype.postMessage = new Proxy(Worker.prototype.postMessage,{apply(a, b, c) {if(c[0]&&c[0].eaglercraftXOpts&&c[0].eaglercraftXOpts.hooks){delete c[0].eaglercraftXOpts.hooks;}return Reflect.apply(a, b, c);}});

    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = dataURL;
    document.body.appendChild(script);
})();
</script></body></html>
